summary: Support wellmanifest/new-project scaffold ID across migration, work-start, and seed checks (0.20.154)

delivery.outcome: Accept minimal policy-free Wellman scaffolds with standard.id 'wellmanifest/new-project' and strict SemVer 2.0.0 versions across create_adoption_lock.py, work_start_check.py, and governance_check.py initial_adoption_seed_paths, bind nested Python sub-package __version__ checks in check_version_parity to their enclosing sub-package manifest when present, synchronize _bundled/governance_check.py, and release standard 0.20.154.
nonGoals: No acceptance of native new-project.governance/v2 manifests, sourceRevision-bound manifests, or non-minimal custom manifests as legacy scaffolds
No changes to target repositories inside this Governance Hub ticket

architecture.decision: Include 'wellmanifest/new-project' in the closed WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES set in scripts/create_adoption_lock.py, scripts/work_start_check.py, and scripts/governance_check.py, align initial_adoption_seed_paths with WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES and pre-release SemVer validation, synchronize packages/wellman/src/wellman/_bundled/governance_check.py via sync_bundled.py, add regression coverage, and advance 0.20.154 version projections.
interfaceChanges: scripts/governance_check.py initial_adoption_seed_paths accepts canonical WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES including wellmanifest/new-project under strict SemVer 2.0.0 validation, and check_version_parity validates nested sub-package initializers against their enclosing sub-package manifest version
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected review; existing native adoption locks and ticket schemas remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: validate_wellman_scaffold migrates minimal wellmanifest/new-project and profile:* scaffolds and refuses native, custom, and unknown manifests.
bootstrap_scaffold_at_head and initial_adoption_seed_paths accept minimal wellmanifest/new-project and profile:* scaffolds while preserving foreign bytes and refusing invalid bases.
Bundled parity, version 0.20.154 parity, wheel build, and Governance Hub gate pass.
